title: PlethoraProductDocFrontmatter
description: Schema definition for canonical Plethora product documentation markdown frontmatter

id.description: Stable hierarchical feature identifier (e.g. tts.word_highlighting, queue.precision.postpone)

platforms.description: Supported target platforms and display modes

summary.description: Concise 1-2 sentence description of what the feature does

how_to.description: Actionable step-by-step instructions on how to use the feature

why.description: Algorithmic, cognitive, or design rationale explaining why the feature behaves as it does

aliases.description: Common synonyms, colloquial terms, and alternative keywords for retrieval

settings.description: Associated store setting keys or config parameters

label.description: User-facing button label (e.g. Open E-ink Settings)

actions.description: Safe allowlisted interactive UI actions attached to this feature

related.description: Related feature IDs or concept document references

version_added.description: Plethora release version where feature was introduced

last_verified_commit.description: Git commit or HEAD reference where behavior was last code-verified
